name: npm/@thirdstrandstudio/mcp-figma
title: Figma
description: Figma design files: layouts, comments, components, libraries, and team collaboration.

toolsSummary.name: figma_get_file
toolsSummary.description: Fetch a Figma file by file key, including node tree and metadata.

toolsSummary.name: figma_get_file_nodes
toolsSummary.description: Load specific nodes (frames, components) from a file key.

toolsSummary.name: figma_get_images
toolsSummary.description: Export or render image URLs for nodes in a file.

toolsSummary.name: figma_get_comments
toolsSummary.description: Read file comments, optionally as Markdown.

toolsSummary.name: figma_get_team_components
toolsSummary.description: List team components and libraries for reuse.

io.sami/gallery.about: Wraps the Figma REST API as MCP tools: files, images, components, comments, team projects, webhooks, and library analytics, authenticated with a personal access token in Sami.
